title: Green triangles near LAX are airliner bokeh

tellings.quote: Also, the triangular, all the shows show these triangular green-shaped UAPs near LAX. They're not.

plain: The green triangle-shaped objects filmed near Los Angeles International Airport, which many shows present as unidentified craft, are in fact just airliners' lights blurred by the camera lens, according to the skeptic Michael Shermer. He says this in a debate with Michels, without pointing to a source, flatly calling the triangles "not" what the shows claim.
